cronjobs.name: ALYGN: Municipal Outreach Daily
cronjobs.description: Daily municipal outreach for Costa Rica cantons with test mode and personalization

payload.message:
Execute Municipal Outreach Pipeline for Costa Rica with PERSONALIZATION:

STEP 1: Discovery
- Run: cd $HOME/.openclaw/workspace && node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/discovery/muni-discovery.js
- Loads 82 cantones from costa-rica-real-municipalities.json

STEP 2: Research
- Run: node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/research/muni-research.js
- Finds mayor names/emails from pre-verified data
- Output: /tmp/muni-researched.json

STEP 3: Personalization (CRITICAL - NEW REQUIREMENTS)
- Run: node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/personalization/muni-personalizer.js --input=/tmp/muni-researched.json
- Generates Spanish emails using Grok with MANDATORY personalization

**BODY TEXT PERSONALIZATION REQUIREMENTS:**
- Include 1-2 sentences connecting recipient's specific work to Alygn
- Reference their recent initiatives, digital governance projects, or public statements
- Example: "Dado su liderazgo en la modernización de servicios digitales en San José, entiende la importancia de la coordinación institucional..."
- Example: "Su reciente anuncio sobre gobernanza digital alinea con nuestro enfoque en infraestructura de coordinación..."

**SPANISH P.D. SECTION (REQUIRED):**
Add this P.D. section at the end of every municipal email:
```
P.D.: Como pioneros en implementación de gobernanza de IA en Costa Rica, 
su municipio tiene la oportunidad de liderar la región en coordinación 
institucional. Este mensaje fue generado con IA y verificado por humanos.
```

- Replaces ALL placeholders: {mayor_name}, {municipality}, {personalized_pain_point}, etc.
- Output: /tmp/muni-personalized.json

STEP 4: Send (Test Mode - TEST ONLY)
- Run: node scripts/alygn/muni-outreach/sending/email-sender-smtp-v2.js --input=/tmp/muni-personalized.json --test-email=contact@andler.dev --approved --limit=5
- Sends to contact@andler.dev (test redirect)
- Requires --approved flag for safety

TEMPLATE PARAMETERS:
- recipientName: municipality.contacts.mayor_name (e.g., 'Luis Diego Miranda')
- municipality: municipality.name (e.g., 'San José')
- painPoints: municipality.pain_points.join(', ') (e.g., 'budget shortages, poor planning, drug trafficking')
- subject: Generated by personalizer (e.g., 'Alianza Estratégica para la Salvaguarda Institucional - San José')
- bodyHtml: Full personalized body with 1-2 sentences connecting their work to Alygn + Spanish P.D. section
- bodyText: Auto-generated from HTML via htmlToText()
- variant: 'governance' | 'institutional' (auto-selected based on municipality characteristics)
- footer: Optional custom footer (uses template default if not provided)
- useCid: false (uses base64 PNG logo)

REPORTING:
- Post summary to Discord #annotations (1466532145257255004)
- Include: sent count, municipality names, message IDs, personalization examples, any errors
- Attach /tmp/muni-sent.json for full details

cronjobs.name: ALYGN: VC Outreach Daily
cronjobs.description: Daily VC outreach for investor relations with test mode and personalization

payload.message:
Execute VC Outreach Pipeline with PERSONALIZATION:

STEP 1: Load VCs from Notion
- Query database: 30b33487-4af6-8106-8cba-d304fdd0b600
- Filter: status = 'Ready for outreach'
- Limit: 5 VCs per run

STEP 2: Research for Personalization (CRITICAL - NEW REQUIREMENT)
- Use Grok/Perplexity to research each VC before drafting:
  * Recent investments (last 12 months)
  * Investment thesis and focus areas
  * Partner backgrounds (Stanford GSB, Super Evolution thesis, etc.)
  * Portfolio companies in AI/governance/coordination space

STEP 3: Generate Drafts with Personalization
- Run: cd $HOME/.openclaw/workspace && node scripts/alygn/vc-outreach/email/draft-outreach-emails.js --limit=5
- Generates 3 subject options per VC (A/B/C testing)
- Selects variant (governance|institutional) based on VC research

**BODY TEXT PERSONALIZATION REQUIREMENTS:**
- Include 1-2 sentences connecting recipient's specific work to Alygn
- Reference their investments, thesis, or recent deals
- Example: "Given your investment in Anthropic, you understand the coordination challenges AI labs face..."
- Example: "Your thesis on frontier tech aligns with our approach to governance infrastructure..."
- Example: "Your recent investment in [Company] shows your commitment to AI safety..."

**PS PERSONALIZATION REQUIREMENTS (VC EMAILS):**
- Reference specific partner background when available:
  * "P.S.: I noticed you studied at Stanford GSB — your work on [topic] resonates with our coordination thesis."
  * "P.S.: Your Super Evolution thesis on [focus] directly aligns with how we think about institutional AI governance."
  * "P.S.: Having backed [Portfolio Company], you understand the governance infrastructure gap we're addressing."

- Saves drafts to scripts/alygn/vc-outreach/drafts/
- Posts to Discord #annotations for review

STEP 4: Send (Test Mode - TEST ONLY)
- Run: node scripts/alygn/vc-outreach/email/send-approved-emails.js --limit=5 --test-email=contact@andler.dev --approved
- Sends to contact@andler.dev (test redirect)
- Updates Notion status to 'Sent'
- Requires --approved flag for safety

TEMPLATE PARAMETERS:
- recipientName: vc.partners[0].split(' ')[0] (first name only, e.g., 'John')
- companyName: vc.name (e.g., 'Radical Ventures')
- painPoints: vc.painPoints.join(', ') (e.g., 'AI safety, governance coordination, regulatory uncertainty')
- subject: subjects.optionA (selected from A/B/C options, e.g., 'The Real AI Risk is Coordination Failure')
- bodyHtml: Full personalized body with 1-2 connecting sentences + personalized P.S.
- bodyText: Auto-generated from HTML via htmlToText()
- variant: 'governance' | 'institutional' (auto-selected based on focusAreas and painPoints)
- footer: Optional custom footer (uses template default if not provided)
- useCid: false (uses base64 PNG logo)

REPORTING:
- Post summary to Discord #annotations (1466532145257255004)
- Include: VC names, subjects used, personalization examples, message IDs, Notion updates, any errors
- Update Notion status to 'Sent' with sent date and message ID
